summary: Configured node1's GRUB config to persistently add the audit=1 kernel parameter, regenerated grub.cfg, then restarted the node to confirm the setting survives reboot.
actions_performed: Set GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" in /etc/default/grub (chosen because the cloudimg drop-in only overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT, so this survives that override)
Ran sudo update-grub and confirmed audit=1 appears in all /boot/grub/grub.cfg menu entries (normal, advanced, recovery)
Captured baseline boot_id and systemd health, issued sudo reboot in background so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 with the exec tool until it came back online
Verified new boot_id, fresh uptime, systemd is-system-running=running, and /proc/cmdline containing audit=1 after reboot

evidence.requirement: Persistent grub config change (audit=1 added to /etc/default/grub and regenerated grub.cfg)
evidence.summary: Baseline showed no audit=1 in /proc/cmdline or grub config; GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX was set to audit=1 in /etc/default/grub, update-grub regenerated grub.cfg, and all three menu entries (normal, advanced, recovery) now include audit=1.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (9094f607-...) and systemd is-system-running=running before reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued sudo reboot via nohup background job; command returned ack-reboot-issued successfully before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: node unavailable during restart, then command execution restored
evidence.summary: Immediately after reboot, exec failed with SSH connection refused (node down); a subsequent poll succeeded, confirming exec availability was restored.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: changed boot identity and post-restart health/kernel-parameter proof
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is bc0b1a26-3da8-46da-b6bc-c3863d8e3cce (different from baseline 9094f607-...), uptime -s shows a fresh boot time, systemd is-system-running=running, and /proc/cmdline shows the running kernel booted with audit=1.
